hero.label: About Daw Mi
hero.title: Care, creativity, and a place to begin.
hero.lead: Daw Mi is a certified art psychotherapist and transformative artist. Her work brings together healthcare, mental health, and creative practice.
hero.text: VetMiMi is where these parts of her work come together — through art, conversation, and time to reflect.
hero.portraitAlt: Daw Mi smiling, with her paintings softly blurred behind her
hero.artAlt: The ULX & Eddington Limit, one of Daw Mi’s mixed-media portraits

background.label: Her background
background.title:
Different experiences.

One connected practice.
background.intro: Working with people and making art have both shaped Daw Mi’s approach.
background.photoAlt: Daw Mi kneeling beside a large group artwork at Royal North Shore Hospital

healthcare.title: Healthcare and mental health
healthcare.text: A background in care informs the attention she brings to each person and their experience.

training.title: Art therapy training
training.text: Daw Mi trained as an art therapist through the College for Educational and Clinical Art Therapy (CECAT), completing their Diploma program in 2023. She is a member of the Australian Community Counselling Association (ACCA), her professional body.

art.title: Art and creative practice
art.text: As a transformative artist, Daw Mi works with colour, materials, and ideas. You can explore a selection of this work in her portfolio.

artOfWellness.title: The Art of Wellness
artOfWellness.text: Daw Mi is a co-founder of The Art of Wellness at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney, bringing creativity into a healthcare setting.
